ch12.card: Part 10 of 10. Creative mode: what it does when it gets stuck.
ch12.s01.c1: Think about the last time you got stuck on a puzzle. What did you do? You did not just stare at it.
ch12.s01.c2: You tried an idea, checked it, and tried another one. That is the whole trick.
ch12.s01.c3: Our model can do the same, but only when it is stuck. This is a picture only.
ch12.s02.c1: First, the model makes one careful best-guess try, with creative mode switched off.
ch12.s02.c2: Then it checks that try on the question's own examples. This one is a made-up example.
ch12.s02.c3: If the try does not fit the examples, the model counts itself stuck. A fixed script does this check.
ch12.s03.c1: Only now does it try lots of ideas. First, 32 sampled tries.
ch12.s03.c2: If none of the 32 fits, it gets 480 more, so 512 in all. The fan here is a picture only, and which tries fit is made up.
ch12.s03.c3: A question it already solved gets no extra tries.
ch12.s04.c1: A checker runs every try on the examples that came with the question. It needs no answer key. The numbers here are a made-up example.
ch12.s04.c2: A try that fits every example is kept. The rest are thrown away.
ch12.s04.c3: For each question, it keeps at most 2 different fitting tries to practise on.
ch12.s05.c1: Did it work? We tried it on an older small design, on two trial copies, with development questions.
ch12.s05.c2: The search worked. On multi-step questions it found 180 and 237 checked tries. The bars were 75 and 90.
ch12.s05.c3: After two nights, first-try scores on multi-step questions rose 10.4 and 9.7 points. The bar was 10.
ch12.s05.c4: Copy B gained 15 of 154 questions, where 16 were needed. So it is not a pass, and it is not proved wrong.
ch12.s06.c1: At night, it practises on its own checked tries. That is the sleep from Part 9.
ch12.s06.c2: Two nights, with a day of search between them.
ch12.s06.c3: On two copies, harm to old skills was minus 1.1 and minus 1.5 points. Below zero means no forgetting.
ch12.s06.c4: Multi-step first tries matched the standard nights, at minus 1.9 and plus 1.9 points. That was on two older small copies only. A check on six copies has not been run.
ch12.s07.c1: Where does it stand as of Oct 11? Creative mode is planned for the first big run, in a day-and-night phase after the main training.
ch12.s07.c2: It has four parts: the stuck test, the stuck-first search, the example checker, and the nights. All are built, with unit tests only, but not yet run on the big design.
ch12.s07.c3: One thing was dropped from that run: the small creative add-on, because it did not survive the nights.
ch12.s07.c4: Sealed tests at 3M and 10M are planned, not yet run. So far it has passed only on older small designs. Next, the wrap-up: what is proven, what is not, and what comes next.
